description: The file defines a React component called GameHistory that displays the history of moves made in a game of Tic Tac Toe, allowing users to jump to specific moves.

methods.name: formatMove
methods.description: Formats the move made by a player into a readable string indicating which player moved and to what position.

methods.name: findDifference
methods.description: Finds the difference between the previous and current game states to determine which position was changed.

methods.name: getPositionDescription
methods.description: Converts a given index into a human-readable row and column description.

methods.name: renderBoard
methods.description: Renders the game board representation for a specific move in the history.

methods.name: jumpTo
methods.description: Dispatches an action to jump to a specific move in the game history.
